top_stories.title: eMudhra security blunder left trusted CA signing keys exposed to anyone
top_stories.summary: Indian certificate authority eMudhra exposed private keys for eight intermediate certificates due to critically weak key generation, allowing anyone to recover the keys from public certificates in under a second. The flaw was discovered by security researcher Wayne on October 17 while checking the Common CA Database (CCADB), affecting a CA that has issued over 60 million digital certificates.

top_stories.title: Okta Advances Agent Identity Framework as Market Builds Around Pre-GA Standards
top_stories.summary: Okta is advancing an agent identity framework to address security vulnerabilities in how AI agents authenticate, specifically targeting the problem of static, long-lived API keys used in agentic workflows. The initiative focuses on replacing plaintext or configuration-file-stored credentials with a more secure identity infrastructure for AI agents, built around pre-GA standards in the emerging market.

top_stories.title: Tech Giants Block eMudhra Certificates Tied to 8 Compromised Keys
top_stories.summary: Major tech platforms including Google, Mozilla, Apple, and the Go project blocked certificates from Indian certificate authority eMudhra after 8 cryptographic keys were found to be compromised. The nature of the key compromise remains unclear, but the action affects PKI trust chains relevant to authentication and identity verification systems.

top_stories.title: BeyondTrust Remote Support Zero-Day Continues Trend of Exploited Edge Bugs
top_stories.summary: BeyondTrust's Remote Support product was hit by a zero-day vulnerability, joining Ivanti, Cisco, and Palo Alto Networks in a wave of exploited edge device bugs in the same week. BeyondTrust is a privileged access management (PAM) vendor, making this vulnerability directly relevant to organizations relying on its remote support and privileged access infrastructure.

top_stories.title: Delinea gives AI assistants read-only access to governance data
top_stories.summary: Delinea has launched the Delinea Fastpath MCP Server, which connects access governance data to AI assistants via the Model Context Protocol (MCP). The capability allows finance, IT, audit, and compliance teams to query access risk, access reviews, audit readiness, and segregation of duties conflicts using natural language.

news.title: AI agent permissions are outrunning security
news.summary: A survey of 1,100 IT and security decision-makers found that 70% of organizations now allow AI agents to make decisions and take actions that previously required human approval. Three in four organizations experienced at least one AI-related security issue in the past year, with excessive or poorly managed AI agent permissions identified as a contributing factor.

news.title: LiteLLM Compromised in Supply Chain Attack Delivering Credential Stealer and Backdoor
news.summary: The LiteLLM Python package (version 1.107.0) was compromised in a supply chain attack that delivered a credential stealer and backdoor via PyPI wheels and Docker images. The package has since been quarantined on PyPI, with the attack documented by security firms SafeDep, Socket, StepSecurity, and Upwind.

news.title: Close Identity Gaps in Software Development Before Unleashing AI
news.summary: A Dark Reading roundtable examined how AI is creating identity security challenges in the software development life cycle. CISOs identified improved identity visibility and collaboration as key strategies for closing identity gaps introduced by AI in development workflows.

news.title: Zeabur shutting down after second security breach in two months
news.summary: Zeabur, a development platform, suffered a second security breach in two months after an attacker used leaked internal credentials stored in plaintext to compromise its infrastructure. The attacker stole over 3.2 million environment variable records and account information for 321,810 users.

news.title: Eight eMudhra CA Keys Compromised, Triggering Emergency Fixes Across Browsers and Software
news.summary: Eight eMudhra intermediate certificate authority (CA) private keys were compromised, confirmed by Mozilla and Google's Chrome Root Program on October 20. The compromise allows anyone holding these keys to issue fraudulent certificates for any website that browsers would accept, triggering emergency remediation across major browsers and software.

news.title: Qilin and INC Ransomware Groups Exploit Palo Alto Networks Flaw to Bypass MFA
news.summary: Ransomware groups Qilin and INC are exploiting CVE-2026-0257, a patched authentication bypass flaw in Palo Alto Networks PAN-OS and Prisma Access, to establish unauthorized VPN connections and bypass MFA. The vulnerability, which carries a CVSS score of 7.8, was patched by Palo Alto Networks in May 2026 but exploitation activity continues to be observed.

news.title: ConnectWise Resets Credentials as Cloud Backup Remains Offline After Security Incident
news.summary: ConnectWise reset account credentials and replaced application credentials following a security incident that resulted in unauthorized access to application identities associated with its Cloud Backup product. Remediation measures also included strengthening administrative-access protections as the company continued its incident response.

news.title: Securing AI agent identity with X.509 PKI on AWS
news.summary: The article presents a reference architecture for securing AI agent identity using X.509 PKI, combining Keyfactor EJBCA and AWS services. The solution incorporates signed request envelopes, delegation assertions, RFC 8693 audience-scoped tokens, and certificate-based cryptographic identity for multi-agent AI systems.

news.title: Tools for Humanity Joins Zoom ISV Exchange Program; Expands Proof of Human Access to Zoom's Business Customers
news.summary: Tools for Humanity has joined the Zoom ISV Exchange Program, making World ID for Zoom available in the Zoom Marketplace. The integration provides enterprises with human presence verification capabilities to authenticate real human identity and combat deepfakes in video communications.

news.title: Oak Research Finds More Than Half of Security Leaders Can't Fully See Who, or What, Has Access to Their Systems
news.summary: Oak Research released findings showing that more than half of security leaders lack full visibility into who or what has access to their systems. The study highlights persistent visibility gaps, unreachable applications, and ungoverned non-human identities as ongoing challenges in identity management, with AI agents increasing complexity.

news.title: CRM SSO: How single sign-on works in practice
news.summary: The article explains how single sign-on works in the context of CRM systems, covering identity provider authentication and protocols such as SAML and OpenID Connect. It is an educational/explainer piece focused on a specific SSO use case rather than reporting on new developments, research, or vendor news.

news.title: The Agent Governance Tax: Enterprises Are Buying Four Layers of Control Before Proving One Layer of Value
news.summary: Three enterprise vendors shipped AI agent governance stacks within 27 days, with Okta launching Agent SSO at Oktane on September 22 as part of a broader general availability release. The article examines the emerging multi-layer control stack enterprises are adopting for AI agent identity and access management before proving business value.

news.title: Microsoft wants to limit AI agents’ permissions when they stray from the job
news.summary: Microsoft introduced Guardian Agents as part of Project Perception, a system designed to dynamically limit AI agents' permissions based on activity, risk, security context, and organizational policy changes. The solution applies least-privilege and containment principles to AI agent authorization, automatically adjusting access and helping security teams investigate risk changes and apply remediation measures.

news.title: Microsoft 365 E7 adds Project Perception to stop rogue AI agents inside companies
news.summary: Microsoft has launched Microsoft 365 E7, a new enterprise security suite that includes Project Perception and Agent 365 to monitor and control AI agent activity within organizations. The tools address internal threats from agentic AI systems, which relates directly to identity and access management concerns around authorization and behavior monitoring of non-human identities.

news.title: AWS IAM Identity Center simplifies identity source changes from Active Directory
news.summary: AWS IAM Identity Center has updated its functionality to retain workforce identities and their assignments when changing identity sources from Active Directory to external IdPs like Okta or Microsoft Entra ID. This change simplifies identity source migrations by eliminating the need to reassign permissions and roles after switching providers.

news.title: ConnectWise Disables Cloud Backups Amid Concerns for Downstream MSPs
news.summary: ConnectWise disabled cloud backups after researchers reported attackers used ConnectWise credentials to authenticate into Microsoft 365 tenants. ConnectWise states customer impact remains unconfirmed while the incident raises concerns for downstream managed service providers.

news.title: Microsoft targets the ‘agentic insider’ with new controls for rogue AI agents
news.summary: Microsoft introduced new security controls designed to limit what AI agents can do as their assessed risk increases, addressing the emerging threat of rogue AI agents in enterprise environments. The controls target "agentic insider" risks where autonomous AI agents could misuse access or permissions, placing this squarely within identity and access governance frameworks.

news.title: When AI becomes ‘Sally from accounts’: The new identity risk facing businesses
news.summary: The article addresses emerging identity risks posed by AI agents given human-like personas, names, and job titles within enterprise environments. The concern centers on how anthropomorphized AI identities may be granted excessive trust, creating new challenges for identity verification and access management.

news.title: Microsoft Treats AI Agents as Insiders — and the Containment Layer Just Arrived
news.summary: Microsoft announced an expansion of Project Perception on October 19, treating internal AI agents as insider identities requiring containment rather than perimeter authentication. The approach applies insider-style access controls and containment layers to AI agents operating within enterprise environments, representing a shift in how identity and authorization models apply to non-human identities.

news.title: Microsoft Has a Strategy to Secure AI Agents
news.summary: Microsoft has formalized a security strategy for AI agents, centered on a zero-trust approach to AI systems. The strategy addresses identity and access management concerns for AI agents, which increasingly require authentication and authorization controls similar to human identities.

news.title: Automate Active Directory joins for Elastic Beanstalk Windows applications
news.summary: AWS Elastic Beanstalk has added automated Active Directory domain joining for Windows Server instances, eliminating the need for manual join scripts or stored domain credentials. The feature performs domain joining at instance launch before application deployment, integrating cloud workloads with Active Directory identity infrastructure.

news.title: Microsoft Patches More Than 1,400 Security Flaws
news.summary: Microsoft released a patch update addressing more than 1,400 security vulnerabilities across Windows and other software products. This exceeds the previous record of approximately 1,000 fixes issued in September, which itself was roughly ten times the typical monthly patch volume.

news.title: Microsoft Plugs Nearly 1,000 Security Holes
news.summary: Microsoft released a record-breaking patch batch addressing at least 974 security vulnerabilities across Windows and other software. The company attributed the increased vulnerability discovery rate to AI assistance, while security experts note organizations are struggling to prioritize and deploy the high volume of monthly fixes.
